messages:
alex: Heads up — saw repeated 99.99th pct tail spikes from gpu-pool rack18-*/hosts over the last 2 hours. Correlating with KV cache miss storm and a ton of retransmits on the rack switch.

sophia: ugh. any clear signal? noisy neighbor or network? :thinking_face:

alex: packet reassembly errors + partial frames in dmesg on a couple hosts. suspect MTU mismatch somewhere between the host NICs and top-of-rack. logs:

alex: ```
[ 12345.678901] r8169 0000:03:00.0 eth0: RX-err: dropped partial frame (frag_len=1220)
[ 12345.679012] TCP: bad checksum from 10.12.18.21
```

ben: that's consistent with jumbo frames being enabled on the host but disabled on the ToR or vice versa. KV cache replication does small chunk bursts; fragmentation kills throughput and increases CPU on NICs.

nina: which fleet subset? only dedicated slices or shared hosts too?

alex: mostly shared tenants on rack18 and neighboring rack19. Dedicated pools mostly fine but spillback routes started hitting those racks as warm pools saturated.

ops-runner: infra-bot detected increased packet loss on rack18 at 2026-03-23T14:02:10Z and opened alert #INC-20260323-18

infra-bot: Alert INC-20260323-18: rack18 ToR port flapped, egress retransmit rate > 4% for 10m. Assigned to eng-infra.

sophia: can we pin the spillback routing away from those racks while we triage? add soft-avoid policy for 10m?

ben: yea, leaning to immediate routing workaround. `route-weight` bump to 0.1 for rack18 for 15m then re-evaluate.

nina: doing a quick check: `ethtool -k` on two affected hosts:

nina: ```
$ ethtool -k eth0
TSO: on
GSO: on
GRO: off
```

alex: ToR config shows MTU 9000 on some ports, 1500 on others. Oops. Looks like recent cabling work didn't normalize settings.

sophia: can ops set soft-avoid and we run controlled warmup to move KV load off? we don't want slab evictions on shared hosts.

ops-runner: applied soft-avoid for rack18 (weight=0.12, ttl=20m). rolling warmup started to shift traffic.

ben: also propose immediate host-side mitigations: disable TSO/GSO until ToR MTU is fixed to avoid partial frames: `ethtool -K eth0 tso off gso off` on affected hosts.

nina: I'll run that on the 6 hosts with the RX-err logs. small impact on CPU but reduces retransmits.

alex: after disabling GSO/TSO on first two hosts, retransmits dropped to 0.4% and 99.99th latency for their slots recovered by ~120ms.

sophia: nice. next steps: ops tickets to normalize MTU across rack18/19 ToR & hosts, hardware check on the patched port, and run an intrusive canary to verify KV replication stability.

ben: can we also add a scheduling rule to avoid packing multiple noisy tenants on same PCIe switch until the network is healthy? quick policy tweak.

ops-runner: created ticket INFRA-2541 (ToR MTU mismatch), INFRA-2542 (rack18 port hw diag), and INFRA-2543 (temporary scheduler anti-coalesce rule). Assigned.

alex: great. leaving this thread open while we watch for regressions. ping me if tail jumps back up. :+1:
